# Repair the EPIC protocol laboratory

Implement `/app/submission/main.py`, a Python 3.11 program using only the standard library. It reads UTF-8 JSON Lines from stdin and writes exactly one JSON object per input line. It must implement three operations: `replay`, `audit`, and `export`. Run it as `python3 -I /app/submission/main.py`; no arguments, networking, subprocesses, external files, or third-party packages are needed. Only `/app/submission/` is collected. All required code must be in regular `.py` files there; total submission size is at most 1 MiB. The initial implementation is a stub.

The task is an original finite abstraction inspired by EPIC's Mode-III pipe and formal verification, particularly cumulative acknowledgments, independent windows, and safe buffer reuse. It is not the author's RoCE implementation. Sequence numbers are unbounded mathematical integers in the specified finite range, never wrapping transport PSNs. Each sequence is one vector-valued AllReduce invocation. A star has one switch and `P` ranks. Inputs are authenticated and never corrupt in transit. Loss, duplication, reordering, and timeout scheduling remain environmental choices. No finite replay is required to terminate. The graph audit makes termination claims only under its explicit fairness assumptions. No hardware is required.

## Common input and errors

Every request has `op` and `inputs`. `inputs` is a rank-major rectangular array of shape `P x R x D`: `1 <= P <= 8`, `0 <= R <= 128`, `0 <= D <= 32`; entries are integers in `[-1000000000,1000000000]`. When `R=0`, `D` is defined to be zero. Empty vectors (`D=0`) model barriers. Exact integer addition is used. The expected result for sequence `q` is the componentwise sum of `inputs[r][q]` over all ranks, including equal-valued contributions separately.

Reject unknown/missing keys, wrong JSON types (booleans are not integers), nonrectangular arrays, duplicate graph triples, duplicate action names, duplicate slot sequence numbers, and duplicate rank entries within a slot with `{"error":"E_SCHEMA"}`. Reject numeric range, string length, and collection-size bounds with `{"error":"E_LIMIT"}`. JSON syntax, duplicate object keys, nonfinite numeric tokens, or invalid UTF-8 yield `{"error":"E_JSON"}`. Whitespace-only lines are invalid JSON. Errors affect only that line; continue with the next line. Error objects have exactly the single `error` key. No traceback or diagnostic may appear on stdout. Cases violating more than one error category need only produce one applicable category.

Input lines, excluding the newline, are at most 32 MiB. An oversized line yields `E_LIMIT`, then parsing resumes at the next newline. Valid inputs use JSON strings of at most 64 ASCII characters where a name is required; action names must match `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}`. Output object key order and whitespace do not matter. No other output keys are permitted.

## `replay`: the bounded switch and its two acknowledgment paths

The exact request keys are `op,inputs,slots,window,events`; `1 <= slots <= 16`, `1 <= window <= slots`. `events` has at most 20000 arrays, each one of:

* `["send", rank, q]`, where `0 <= rank < P`, `0 <= q < R`;
* `["retry", rank]`;
* `["deliver", packet_id]`, `["drop", packet_id]`, or `["duplicate", packet_id]`, with `0 <= packet_id <= 200000`.

All state starts empty or zero. Each host has `sent` (its cumulatively acknowledged upstream prefix length) and `received` (an ordered list of result vectors). The switch has `floor=0`, `up_next[r]=0`, and `acked[r]=0`. Its circular buffer has `slots` physical entries indexed by `q % slots`; each occupied entry retains its absolute sequence tag `q`, a set of contributing ranks, and their vector sum. A full entry contains all `P` ranks. Never clear a slot on aggregation or on an upstream ACK. It is released only by the minimum of all downstream cumulative ACKs.

A packet has exactly `id,kind,rank,seq,value`. Kinds are `up,uack,down,dack`. `up` and `down` carry vector `value`; ACKs carry `null`. Data `seq` is a sequence index; ACK `seq` is an exclusive prefix length. `rank` identifies the host on either direction. Packets are immutable once created. IDs are consecutive from zero in creation order. Every creation appends to the pending packet map. Deliver/drop remove the named pending packet before further processing. A duplicate creates an identical packet with a fresh ID and retains the original. A missing ID makes the event `missing` and changes nothing.

Process events sequentially:

1. `send`: enabled precisely when `sent[rank] <= q < min(R,sent[rank]+window)`. Create one `up` with the original input vector. Otherwise return event status `disabled`, changing nothing. Sending an already pending request is allowed.
2. `retry`: for that rank, create `down` packets for every full occupied entry with `q >= acked[rank]`, in increasing `q` order. It is always enabled, even if it creates nothing. This is the switch timeout, independent of host transmission progress.
3. Deliver `up(r,q)`: if `floor <= q < floor+slots`, find/create the tagged entry and add the contribution only if `r` is absent. Then advance `up_next[r]` while the entry for that sequence exists and contains `r`. Create one `uack(r,up_next[r])`. If this arrival changed the entry from incomplete to full, create `down` packets to ranks `0..P-1` in that order after the ACK. A duplicate full contribution does not regenerate results. For `q` outside that range, store/aggregate nothing and create only `uack(r,up_next[r])`; an unchanged cumulative ACK also serves as a negative acknowledgment. In particular, old packets cannot alias a reused slot.
4. Deliver `uack(r,k)`: set `sent[r]=max(sent[r],k)`.
5. Deliver `down(r,q,v)`: if `q == len(received[r])`, append `v`; otherwise discard the data, including ahead-of-order data. In all cases create `dack(r,len(received[r]))`. Previously emitted result packets remain deliverable after slot reuse.
6. Deliver `dack(r,k)`: set `acked[r]=max(acked[r],k)`, then `floor=min(acked)`. Clear precisely the occupied entries whose sequence is below the new floor.
7. Drop: no further processing. Duplicate: only the copy described above.

All ordinary events have status `ok`. If a request ever exceeds 2048 simultaneously pending packets or 200000 total packet creations, return `E_LIMIT` for the entire request, with no partial replay response. Those bounds limit only the explicit replay; they are not assumptions of the temporal audit.

The response has exactly `hosts,floor,slots,packets,events`. `hosts` is rank ordered, each entry exactly `{"sent":integer,"received":[vectors...]}`. `slots` is sequence ordered, each entry exactly `{"seq":q,"ranks":[sorted ranks],"sum":vector}`. `packets` is ID ordered and contains every pending packet with the exact five fields above. `events` has one entry per event, exactly `{"status":"ok|disabled|missing","created":[new IDs in creation order]}`. Do not include internal `up_next` or `acked` fields.

## `audit` and `export`: immutable finite protocol-state graphs

Both operations have exactly `op,inputs,states,edges,start,fairness`. There are `1..12000` states, numbered in input order, and `0..60000` explicit edges. `start` is a state index. Each state has exactly:

* `delivered`: a rank-ordered array of `P` arrays of result vectors. Each rank has `0..R` vectors, each width `D`. Position `q` represents result `q`.
* `slots`: at most 16 objects, each exactly `seq,ranks,sum`, with `0 <= seq < R`, rank indices in `0..P-1`, and `sum` of width `D`. Empty rank sets are allowed. Sequence numbers are unique within the state. Rank lists need not be sorted.

All numeric snapshot vector values are integers in `[-2^60,2^60]`. Incorrect sums are valid input and must be detected as unsafe. A state is safe iff every delivered vector equals the corresponding exact AllReduce sum and each slot sum equals the sum of precisely its listed ranks' input vectors for its sequence. A state is done iff each rank has exactly `R` delivered vectors, regardless of safety. Slots need not be full or empty on completion. These are independent predicates.

An edge is `[source,action_name,target]`. It represents one indivisible protocol/network step, including explicit no-op protocol steps. Duplicate triples are invalid. The graph is supplied by an external finite model compiler; this task checks its observational safety and fair termination, not whether every edge follows the replay engine. Graph snapshots may intentionally describe faulty protocol variants. Preserve the graph exactly; do not omit unsafe states, loss/duplication edges, or enabled alternatives.

`fairness` is an array of at most 16 objects, each exactly `{"action":name,"mode":"weak|strong"}`. Action names are unique within this list; a fairness action may have no edges. There may be at most 64 distinct names across edges and fairness. A named action is enabled at a state iff at least one **explicit edge in the complete input graph** with that source has that action, including self-edges and edges leaving a currently examined SCC. It is not computed from a pruned graph.

In addition to explicit edges, every state has an implicit stutter self-edge, denoted by edge ID `-1`. It enables no named action and fulfills no fairness obligation. Explicit edge IDs are their zero-based positions in `edges`. For an infinite path:

* Weak fairness of `a`: if `a` is enabled at every state from some point onward, edges labeled `a` must occur infinitely often.
* Strong fairness of `a`: if `a` is enabled at infinitely many visited states, edges labeled `a` must occur infinitely often.

Safety quantifies over every reachable state without fairness restrictions. Termination means every infinite fair path from `start` visits a done state at least once (`<>Done`), including paths with loss, duplication, retries, explicit no-op actions, and implicit stutters. Do not impose a fairness condition absent from the request. Permanent loss need not terminate. Reachability for a termination counterexample excludes done states throughout its prefix and loop.

For `audit`, return exactly `safe,safety,terminates,liveness`. `safe` and `terminates` are booleans. `safety` is `null` when safe, otherwise `{"prefix":[edge IDs]}`, a finite walk from `start` ending at any unsafe state (empty allowed). `liveness` is `null` when terminating, otherwise `{"prefix":[edge IDs],"loop":[edge IDs]}`. The prefix starts at `start`; the nonempty loop starts at its endpoint and closes there. Repeating the loop must satisfy all declared fairness conditions, and every visited state in prefix and loop must be non-done. Prefixes/loops need not be shortest, simple, or canonical. At most 1000000 total edge IDs may occur in one response. Both predicates must be computed even if one fails. A whole-SCC fairness heuristic is insufficient: a fair nonterminal subcycle can exist in an SCC containing a strongly fair action whose only exits leave that SCC.

## Lossless TLA+ export

For `export`, return exactly `{"module":string,"config":string}`. `module` must be a parsable module named `ModelData`, with only the following eight constant definitions, in this order, following `EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets`: `Nodes,Initial,Edges,ActionNames,WFIds,SFIds,SafeNodes,DoneNodes`. Integers use decimal notation; sets use `{...}`; tuples use `<<...>>`; use no expressions, helper operators, comments, overrides, or other definitions except `Nodes == 0..(n-1)`, written as the concrete range such as `0..3`. Module header/footer are `---- MODULE ModelData ----` and `====`. Whitespace is arbitrary.

`ActionNames` is the tuple of all edge/fairness names sorted in ASCII order. Actions have 1-based tuple indices. `Edges` is the set of `<<source,action_index,target>>` triples for **all** input explicit edges. `WFIds` and `SFIds` contain the corresponding declared action indices. `SafeNodes` and `DoneNodes` contain exactly the state indices satisfying the predicates above. `Initial` is `start`. Sets can be in any order. Empty sets and the empty tuple are permitted. The implicit stutter is represented by the harness, not by adding to `Edges`.

`config` must contain exactly these tokens, with arbitrary whitespace: `SPECIFICATION Spec INVARIANT Safety PROPERTY Termination CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE`. The public image supplies Python, not Java or TLC. Export correctness is checked structurally against all input edges, predicates, and fairness declarations; running TLC is not required of the submission. A maintainer with a separately provisioned TLC installation can optionally save the module as `ModelData.tla` beside the provided immutable `/app/EPIC.tla` and run the supplied configuration. The harness toggles an auxiliary bit on every explicit edge, so explicit self-edges count as action occurrences under TLA+ fairness; implicit stutters do not. Deleting transitions, changing fairness, changing predicates, or replacing the harness cannot satisfy export correctness. The checker can validate the complete exported relation independently of your audit answer. Do not modify `/app/EPIC.tla`.

## Resources and verification

Each invocation receives at most 32 requests and 64 MiB total stdin. It runs with 1 CPU, 60 CPU seconds, 90 seconds wall time, 1024 MiB address space, 32 processes, 64 file descriptors, 64 MiB combined stdout/stderr, and a 64 MiB temporary-work allowance. Output may be at most 16 MiB per line. Use iterative graph traversal for deep graphs. No per-request startup penalty is scored. Agent development has 4 hours and 2 CPUs/2048 MiB/2048 MiB storage; runtime limits above are the separate submission limits. `python3 /app/check_examples.py` checks the small public examples. Hidden verification covers protocol loss/reorder/duplication and reuse, exact arithmetic/barriers, graph safety, mixed fairness with fair subcycles, valid noncanonical witnesses, lossless model export, malformed inputs, and bounded maximum-size cases. Any correct implementation and any valid witness satisfying this contract are accepted. This is a functional task, not a speed competition.

Sources: [EPIC paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18683v2), [official artifact](https://github.com/In-Net/EPIC/tree/b3dd05f8b75a02594e2ebdfb9e569c14d3ecb55d/verify), and [Lamport, Specifying Systems, chapters 8 and 14](https://lamport.azurewebsites.net/tla/book.html). The bounded star, JSON protocol, explicit graph contract, witness format, and TLA+ exporter are new adaptations. Upstream protocol source is not bundled.


Local trial profile: submit /app/submission with main.py and only regular .py files, at most 1 MiB and 10000 total entries; no symlinks or hardlinks. Offline Linux x86-64; no sockets, System V IPC, namespace operations or surviving background processes across tool calls. Agent shell tool has two assigned CPUs, 180 seconds wall per call, 2 GiB virtual memory per process, 64 processes/threads, 256 descriptors and 2 MiB output; individual files are limited to 64 MiB. The agent gets unlimited model calls and a four-hour soft deadline checked before each model query; each physical request has a 14400-second client timeout and the provider-advertised maximum output for this model; a query started before it may issue further retry or output-cap requests and execute returned tool actions after it. The fresh-state verifier forbids child processes and has one CPU, 1 GiB address space, 60 seconds CPU, 90 seconds wall, 64 descriptors, and 64 MiB combined stdout/stderr, checked after capture; individual stdout and stderr streams are each capped at 64 MiB while capturing. The original 64 MiB aggregate scratch limit is not strictly enforced; an emergency storage monitor is sampled, not a quota. The score is binary; infrastructure and interface failures receive no score.

When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT

EXTENDS ModelData
VARIABLES pc, turn
vars == <<pc, turn>>
Init == /\ pc = Initial /\ turn = 0
Move(a) == \E e \in Edges :
    /\ e[1] = pc /\ e[2] = a /\ pc' = e[3] /\ turn' = 1 - turn
Next == \E a \in 1..Len(ActionNames) : Move(a)
Spec == /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
        /\ \A a \in WFIds : WF_vars(Move(a))
        /\ \A a \in SFIds : SF_vars(Move(a))
Safety == pc \in SafeNodes
Termination == <>(pc \in DoneNodes)
====

    idx = [-1]*total

            if pi == 0:

                if idx[w]==-1:
                    work[-1]=(v,pi)
                    work.append((w,0)); recurse=True; break
                elif on[w]:
                    if idx[w]<low[v]: low[v]=idx[w]

            work.pop()
            if low[v]==idx[v]:
                comp=[]
                while True:
                    w=stk.pop(); on[w]=False; comp.append(w)
                    if w==v: break
                comps.append(comp)

                u=work[-1][0]
                if low[v]<low[u]: low[u]=low[v]

MAX_LINE = 32 * 1024 * 1024
VMAX_SNAP = 1 << 60


class Err(Exception):
    def __init__(self, cat):
        Exception.__init__(self, cat)
        self.cat = cat


def isint(x):
    return isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool)


def chk(cond, cat):
    if not cond:
        raise Err(cat)


NAME_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}\Z")


def get_str_name(x):
    if not isinstance(x, str):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    if len(x) > 64:
        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    if NAME_RE.match(x) is None:
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    return x


def check_keys(obj, keys):
    chk(isinstance(obj, dict), "E_SCHEMA")
    if len(obj) != len(keys):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    for k in keys:
        chk(k in obj, "E_SCHEMA")


def check_vec(vec, D, lo, hi):
    chk(isinstance(vec, list), "E_SCHEMA")
    chk(len(vec) == D, "E_SCHEMA")
    for x in vec:
        if not isint(x):
            raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
        if x < lo or x > hi:
            raise Err("E_LIMIT")


def parse_inputs(v):
    """validated rectangular P x R x D array -> (P, R, D, data)"""
    if type(v) is not list:
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    P = len(v)
    if P < 1 or P > 8:
        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    R = None
    for row in v:
        if type(row) is not list:
            raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
        if R is None:
            R = len(row)
        elif len(row) != R:
            raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    if R > 128:
        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    D = None
    for row in v:
        for vec in row:
            if type(vec) is not list:
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            if D is None:
                D = len(vec)
            elif len(vec) != D:
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    if D > 32:
        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    for row in v:
        for vec in row:
            if vec:
                if not all(type(x) is int for x in vec):
                    raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
                if min(vec) < -1000000000 or max(vec) > 1000000000:
                    raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    return P, R, D, v


def expected_sums(inp, P, R, D):
    """expected[q] = sum over all ranks of inputs[r][q]"""
    out = []
    for q in range(R):
        s = [0] * D
        for r in range(P):
            vec = inp[r][q]
            for i in range(D):
                s[i] += vec[i]
        out.append(s)
    return out


def parse_op(v):
    chk(isinstance(v, str), "E_SCHEMA")
    if v not in ("replay", "audit", "export"):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    return v


def parse_events(v, P, R):
    chk(isinstance(v, list), "E_SCHEMA")
    if len(v) > 20000:
        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    out = []
    for ev in v:
        chk(isinstance(ev, list), "E_SCHEMA")
        chk(len(ev) >= 1, "E_SCHEMA")
        k = ev[0]
        if not isinstance(k, str) or k not in ("send", "retry", "deliver", "drop", "duplicate"):
            raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
        if k == "send":
            chk(len(ev) == 3, "E_SCHEMA")
            if not isint(ev[1]):
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            chk(0 <= ev[1] < P, "E_LIMIT")
            if not isint(ev[2]):
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            chk(0 <= ev[2] < R, "E_LIMIT")
        elif k == "retry":
            chk(len(ev) == 2, "E_SCHEMA")
            if not isint(ev[1]):
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            chk(0 <= ev[1] < P, "E_LIMIT")
        else:
            chk(len(ev) == 2, "E_SCHEMA")
            if not isint(ev[1]):
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            chk(0 <= ev[1] <= 200000, "E_LIMIT")
        out.append(ev)
    return out


def do_replay(inp, P, R, D, req):
    slotsn = req["slots"]
    window = req["window"]
    events = parse_events(req["events"], P, R)
    if not isint(slotsn):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    chk(1 <= slotsn <= 16, "E_LIMIT")
    if not isint(window):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    chk(1 <= window <= slotsn, "E_LIMIT")

    buf = [None] * slotsn

    class Ent:
        __slots__ = ("seq", "ranks", "sum")

        def __init__(self, seq):
            self.seq = seq
            self.ranks = set()
            self.sum = [0] * D

    floor = 0
    up_next = [0] * P
    acked = [0] * P
    sentv = [0] * P
    received = [[] for _ in range(P)]
    pending = {}
    total_created = 0
    max_pending = 0
    ev_status = []
    ev_created = []

    def new_packet(kind, rank, seq, value):
        nonlocal total_created
        if len(pending) >= 2048 or total_created >= 200000:
            raise Err("E_LIMIT")
        pid = total_created
        total_created += 1
        pending[pid] = [pid, kind, rank, seq, value]
        return pid

    for ev in events:
        k = ev[0]
        created = []
        if k == "send":
            r = ev[1]
            q = ev[2]
            lim = R
            if sentv[r] + window < lim:
                lim = sentv[r] + window
            if sentv[r] <= q < lim:
                pid = new_packet("up", r, q, list(inp[r][q]))
                created.append(pid)
                st = "ok"
            else:
                st = "disabled"
        elif k == "retry":
            r = ev[1]
            for e in buf:
                if e is not None and e.ranks and len(e.ranks) == P and e.seq >= acked[r]:
                    pid = new_packet("down", r, e.seq, list(e.sum))
                    created.append(pid)
            st = "ok"
        elif k == "drop":
            if pending.pop(ev[1], None) is None:
                ev_status.append("missing")
                ev_created.append([])
                continue
            st = "ok"
        elif k == "duplicate":
            pkt = pending.get(ev[1])
            if pkt is None:
                ev_status.append("missing")
                ev_created.append([])
                continue
            created.append(new_packet(pkt[1], pkt[2], pkt[3], pkt[4]))
            st = "ok"
        else:
            pid = ev[1]
            pkt = pending.pop(pid, None)
            if pkt is None:
                ev_status.append("missing")
                ev_created.append([])
                continue
            kind = pkt[1]
            r = pkt[2]
            q = pkt[3]
            if kind == "up":
                if floor <= q < floor + slotsn:
                    idx = q % slotsn
                    e = buf[idx]
                    if e is None or e.seq != q:
                        e = Ent(q)
                        buf[idx] = e
                    if r not in e.ranks:
                        vec = pkt[4]
                        s = e.sum
                        for i in range(D):
                            s[i] += vec[i]
                        e.ranks.add(r)
                        became_full = len(e.ranks) == P
                    else:
                        became_full = False
                    n = up_next[r]
                    while True:
                        e2 = buf[n % slotsn]
                        if e2 is not None and e2.seq == n and r in e2.ranks:
                            n += 1
                        else:
                            break
                    up_next[r] = n
                    created.append(new_packet("uack", r, n, None))
                    if became_full:
                        s = list(e.sum)
                        for t in range(P):
                            created.append(new_packet("down", t, q, s))
            elif kind == "uack":
                kk = pkt[3]
                if kk > sentv[r]:
                    sentv[r] = kk
            elif kind == "down":
                if q == len(received[r]):
                    received[r].append(pkt[4])
                created.append(new_packet("dack", r, len(received[r]), None))
            elif kind == "dack":
                kk = pkt[3]
                if kk > acked[r]:
                    acked[r] = kk
                    nf = min(acked)
                    if nf > floor:
                        floor = nf
                        for i in range(slotsn):
                            e = buf[i]
                            if e is not None and e.seq < floor:
                                buf[i] = None
            st = "ok"
        ev_status.append(st)
        ev_created.append(created)

    slot_list = []
    for i in range(slotsn):
        e = buf[i]
        if e is not None:
            slot_list.append({"seq": e.seq, "ranks": sorted(e.ranks), "sum": list(e.sum)})
    slot_list.sort(key=lambda x: x["seq"])
    packets = []
    for pid in range(total_created):
        p = pending.get(pid)
        if p is not None:
            packets.append({"id": p[0], "kind": p[1], "rank": p[2], "seq": p[3], "value": p[4]})
    hosts = [{"sent": sentv[r], "received": [list(v) for v in received[r]]} for r in range(P)]
    evout = [{"status": ev_status[i], "created": ev_created[i]} for i in range(len(events))]
    return {"hosts": hosts, "floor": floor, "slots": slot_list, "packets": packets, "events": evout}


def parse_edge(v, nstates):
    chk(isinstance(v, list), "E_SCHEMA")
    chk(len(v) == 3, "E_SCHEMA")
    if not isint(v[0]):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    chk(0 <= v[0] < nstates, "E_LIMIT")
    name = get_str_name(v[1])
    if not isint(v[2]):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    chk(0 <= v[2] < nstates, "E_LIMIT")
    return (v[0], name, v[2])


def parse_fairness(v):
    chk(isinstance(v, list), "E_SCHEMA")
    if len(v) > 16:
        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    out = []
    seen = set()
    for f in v:
        check_keys(f, ("action", "mode"))
        chk(isinstance(f["mode"], str) and f["mode"] in ("weak", "strong"), "E_SCHEMA")
        a = get_str_name(f["action"])
        chk(a not in seen, "E_SCHEMA")
        seen.add(a)
        out.append((a, f["mode"]))
    return out


def parse_states(v, P, R, D):
    if type(v) is not list:
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    if len(v) < 1 or len(v) > 12000:
        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    for f in v:
        keys = list(f.keys()) if isinstance(f, dict) else None
        if keys is None or len(keys) != 2 or "delivered" not in f or "slots" not in f:
            raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
        dl = f["delivered"]
        if type(dl) is not list:
            raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
        if len(dl) != P:
            raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
        for rank in dl:
            if type(rank) is not list:
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            if len(rank) > R:
                raise Err("E_LIMIT")
            for vec in rank:
                if type(vec) is not list:
                    raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
                if len(vec) != D:
                    raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
                if vec:
                    if not all(type(x) is int for x in vec):
                        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
                    if min(vec) < -VMAX_SNAP or max(vec) > VMAX_SNAP:
                        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
        sl = f["slots"]
        if type(sl) is not list:
            raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
        if len(sl) > 16:
            raise Err("E_LIMIT")
        seqs = set()
        for s in sl:
            ks = list(s.keys()) if isinstance(s, dict) else None
            if ks is None or len(ks) != 3 or "seq" not in s or "ranks" not in s or "sum" not in s:
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            if type(s["seq"]) is not int:
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            if not 0 <= s["seq"] < R:
                raise Err("E_LIMIT")
            if s["seq"] in seqs:
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            seqs.add(s["seq"])
            rk = s["ranks"]
            if type(rk) is not list:
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            rkset = set()
            for x in rk:
                if type(x) is not int:
                    raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
                if not 0 <= x < P:
                    raise Err("E_LIMIT")
                if x in rkset:
                    raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
                rkset.add(x)
            sv = s["sum"]
            if type(sv) is not list:
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            if len(sv) != D:
                raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
            if sv:
                if not all(type(x) is int for x in sv):
                    raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
                if min(sv) < -VMAX_SNAP or max(sv) > VMAX_SNAP:
                    raise Err("E_LIMIT")


def parse_graph(inp, P, R, D, req):
    parse_states(req["states"], P, R, D)
    states = req["states"]
    n = len(states)
    edges = req["edges"]
    chk(isinstance(edges, list), "E_SCHEMA")
    if len(edges) > 60000:
        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    elist = []
    names = set()
    seen_e = set()
    for e in edges:
        s, nm, t = parse_edge(e, n)
        key = (s, nm, t)
        chk(key not in seen_e, "E_SCHEMA")
        seen_e.add(key)
        names.add(nm)
        elist.append(key)
    fair = parse_fairness(req["fairness"])
    for a, m in fair:
        names.add(a)
    if len(names) > 64:
        raise Err("E_LIMIT")
    st = req["start"]
    if not isint(st):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    chk(0 <= st < n, "E_LIMIT")
    return states, elist, fair, names, st, n


def done_flags(states, P, R):
    dn = []
    for st in states:
        ok = True
        dl = st["delivered"]
        for r in range(P):
            if len(dl[r]) != R:
                ok = False
                break
        dn.append(ok)
    return dn


def state_is_safe(st, expected, inp, P, R, D):
    dl = st["delivered"]
    for r in range(P):
        arr = dl[r]
        for q in range(len(arr)):
            if arr[q] != expected[q]:
                return False
    for s in st["slots"]:
        tot = [0] * D
        seq = s["seq"]
        for r in s["ranks"]:
            vec = inp[r][seq]
            for i in range(D):
                tot[i] += vec[i]
        if s["sum"] != tot:
            return False
    return True


def build_adj(edges, n, only_live=None):
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for eid, (s, lab, t) in enumerate(edges):
        if only_live is not None:
            if not only_live[s] or not only_live[t]:
                continue
        adj[s].append((eid, t))
    return adj


def adj_plain(edges, n, live):
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for eid, (s, lab, t) in enumerate(edges):
        if live[s] and live[t]:
            adj[s].append((eid, t))
    return adj


def bfs_path(start, adj, n, target_test):
    """returns (path_edge_ids, node) for first node satisfying target_test"""
    par = [-2] * n  # -2 unvisited
    pare = [0] * n
    par[start] = -1
    q = [start]
    qi = 0
    while qi < len(q):
        u = q[qi]
        qi += 1
        if target_test(u):
            path = []
            v = u
            while par[v] != -1:
                path.append(pare[v])
                v = par[v]
            path.reverse()
            return path, u
        for eid, t in adj[u]:
            if par[t] == -2:
                par[t] = u
                pare[t] = eid
                q.append(t)
    return None, None


def state_safety_check(states, expected, inp, P, R, D, edges, n, start):
    live = [True] * n
    adj = adj_plain(edges, n, live)
    res = bfs_path(start, adj, n, lambda u: not state_is_safe(states[u], expected, inp, P, R, D))
    return res


def tarjan_subset(nodes, node_set, adj):
    """SCC of induced subgraph on members (all in node_set); returns list of lists."""
    idx = {}
    low = {}
    onst = set()
    stack = []
    comps = []
    for root in nodes:
        if root in idx:
            continue
        work = [[root, 0]]
        while work:
            fr = work[-1]
            v = fr[0]
            if fr[1] == 0:
                idx[v] = len(idx)
                low[v] = idx[v]
                stack.append(v)
                onst.add(v)
            recurse = False
            av = adj[v]
            ln = len(av)
            pi = fr[1]
            while pi < ln:
                w = av[pi]
                pi += 1
                if w in node_set:
                    if w not in idx:
                        fr[1] = pi
                        work.append([w, 0])
                        recurse = True
                        break
                    elif w in onst and idx[w] < low[v]:
                        low[v] = idx[w]
            if recurse:
                continue
            work.pop()
            if low[v] == idx[v]:
                comp = []
                while True:
                    w = stack.pop()
                    onst.discard(w)
                    comp.append(w)
                    if w == v:
                        break
                comps.append(comp)
            if work:
                u = work[-1][0]
                if low[v] < low[u]:
                    low[u] = low[v]
    return comps


def hierholzer(adj):
    """adj[u] = list of (eid, tgt) entries, each edge copy present exactly once.
    Returns list of edge ids forming an Eulerian circuit from start."""
    nc = len(adj)
    ptr = [0] * nc
    stack = [0]
    pops = []
    while stack:
        u = stack[-1]
        au = adj[u]
        if ptr[u] < len(au):
            en = au[ptr[u]]
            ptr[u] += 1
            stack.append(en[1])
        else:
            pops.append(stack.pop())
    pops.reverse()
    out = []
    for i in range(len(pops) - 1):
        u = pops[i]
        v = pops[i + 1]
        out.append(adj_eid_lookup[u][v].pop(0))
    return out


def build_loop(cprot, adjp, tgt):
    """closed walk of edge ids over protocol subgraph of cprot starting at tgt"""
    nodes = [tgt]
    oid = {tgt: 0}
    for s in cprot:
        if s != tgt:
            oid[s] = len(oid)
            nodes.append(s)
    entries = []  # (root_idx, eid, tgt_idx)
    for s in cprot:
        u = oid[s]
        for eid, t in adjp[s]:
            v = oid[t]
            entries.append((u, eid, v))
            entries.append((u, eid, v))
    nsub = len(entries)
    if nsub == 0:
        return [-1]
    adj = [[] for _ in range(len(oid))]
    for u, eid, v in entries:
        adj[u].append((eid, v))
    ptr = [0] * len(oid)
    stack = [0]
    pops = []
    while stack:
        u = stack[-1]
        au = adj[u]
        if ptr[u] < len(au):
            en = au[ptr[u]]
            ptr[u] += 1
            stack.append(en[1])
        else:
            pops.append(stack.pop())
    pops.reverse()
    lookup = [{} for _ in range(len(oid))]
    for u, eid, v in entries:
        d = lookup[u]
        if v in d:
            d[v].append(eid)
        else:
            d[v] = [eid]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(pops) - 1):
        u = pops[i]
        v = pops[i + 1]
        out.append(lookup[u][v].pop(0))
    return out


def compute_liveness(states, edges, fair, start, n, done, reach):
    weakb = [i for i in range(len(fair)) if fair[i][1] == "weak"]
    strongb = [i for i in range(len(fair)) if fair[i][1] == "strong"]
    DECL = (1 << len(fair)) - 1
    bit = {}
    for i, (a, m) in enumerate(fair):
        bit[a] = 1 << i
    liveb = [reach[s] and not done[s] for s in range(n)]
    live = [s for s in range(n) if liveb[s]]
    result = (True, None)
    if live:
        enm_state = [0] * n
        for s, lab, t in edges:
            b = bit.get(lab)
            if b:
                enm_state[s] |= b
        idmap = {}
        for i, s in enumerate(live):
            idmap[s] = i
        k = len(live)
        adj = [[] for _ in range(k)]
        m_nodes = []
        for eid in range(len(edges)):
            s, lab, t = edges[eid]
            if s in idmap and t in idmap:
                b = bit.get(lab)
                if b is None:
                    adj[idmap[s]].append(idmap[t])
                else:
                    mid = len(adj)
                    adj.append([])
                    m_nodes.append((eid, b))
                    adj[idmap[s]].append(mid)
                    adj[mid].append(idmap[t])
        for i in range(k):
            adj[i].append(i)
        tot = len(adj)
        enmask = [0] * tot
        mmask = [0] * tot
        ymask = [0] * tot
        for i in range(k):
            enm = enm_state[live[i]]
            enmask[i] = enm
            ymask[i] = (~enm) & DECL
        for j, (eid, b) in enumerate(m_nodes):
            nd = k + j
            ymask[nd] = b
            mmask[nd] = b

        allnodes = list(range(tot))
        comps = tarjan_subset(allnodes, set(allnodes), adj)
        members = [c for c in comps]
        work = list(range(len(members)))
        active = [True] * len(members)
        result_comp = None
        while work:
            c = work.pop()
            if not active[c]:
                continue
            mem = members[c]
            orE = 0
            orM = 0
            orY = 0
            for v in mem:
                orE |= enmask[v]
                orM |= mmask[v]
                orY |= ymask[v]
            rm = None
            for a in weakb:
                if not ((orY >> a) & 1):
                    rm = mem
                    break
            if rm is None:
                for a in strongb:
                    if ((orE >> a) & 1) and not ((orM >> a) & 1):
                        bb = 1 << a
                        rm = [v for v in mem if enmask[v] & bb]
                        break
            if rm is None:
                result_comp = mem
                break
            active[c] = False
            if len(rm) == len(mem):
                continue
            rmset = set(rm)
            rem = [v for v in mem if v not in rmset]
            newc = tarjan_subset(rem, set(rem), adj)
            for nc in newc:
                members.append(nc)
                active.append(True)
                work.append(len(members) - 1)

        if result_comp is not None:
            cprot = set()
            for v in result_comp:
                if v < k:
                    cprot.add(live[v])
            adjl = [[] for _ in range(n)]
            for eid in range(len(edges)):
                s, lab, t = edges[eid]
                if liveb[s] and liveb[t]:
                    adjl[s].append((eid, t))
            path, tgt = bfs_path(start, adjl, n, lambda u: u in cprot)
            if path is not None:
                adjp = [[] for _ in range(n)]
                for eid in range(len(edges)):
                    s, lab, t = edges[eid]
                    if s in cprot and t in cprot:
                        adjp[s].append((eid, t))
                loop = build_loop(cprot, adjp, tgt)
                return False, (path, loop)
    return True, None


def do_audit(inp, P, R, D, req):
    states, edges, fair, names, start, n = parse_graph(inp, P, R, D, req)
    expected = expected_sums(inp, P, R, D)
    done = done_flags(states, P, R)
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for eid, (s, lab, t) in enumerate(edges):
        adj[s].append((eid, t))
    par = [-2] * n
    pare = [0] * n
    order = []
    par[start] = -1
    order.append(start)
    qi = 0
    while qi < len(order):
        u = order[qi]
        qi += 1
        for eid, t in adj[u]:
            if par[t] == -2:
                par[t] = u
                pare[t] = eid
                order.append(t)
    reach = [False] * n
    for u in order:
        reach[u] = True
    safeflag = {}
    safe_ok = True
    for u in order:
        f = state_is_safe(states[u], expected, inp, P, R, D)
        safeflag[u] = f
        if not f:
            safe_ok = False
    if safe_ok:
        safety = None
    else:
        par2 = [-2] * n
        par2[start] = -1
        pare2 = [0] * n
        q2 = [start]
        qi = 0
        found = None
        while qi < len(q2):
            u = q2[qi]
            qi += 1
            if not safeflag.get(u, True):
                found = u
                break
            for eid, t in adj[u]:
                if par2[t] == -2:
                    par2[t] = u
                    pare2[t] = eid
                    q2.append(t)
        path = []
        v = found
        while par2[v] != -1:
            path.append(pare2[v])
            v = par2[v]

    terminates, live = compute_liveness(states, edges, fair, start, n, done, reach)
    if live is None:
        liveness = None
    else:
        path, loop = live
        liveness = {"prefix": path, "loop": loop}

def do_export(inp, P, R, D, req):
    states, edges, fair, names, start, n = parse_graph(inp, P, R, D, req)
    expected = expected_sums(inp, P, R, D)
    anames = sorted(names)
    aidx = {}
    for i, a in enumerate(anames):
        aidx[a] = i + 1
    done = done_flags(states, P, R)
    safenodes = []
    for i, st in enumerate(states):
        if state_is_safe(st, expected, inp, P, R, D):
            safenodes.append(i)
    donenodes = [i for i in range(n) if done[i]]
    wf = [str(aidx[a]) for a, m in fair if m == "weak"]
    sf = [str(aidx[a]) for a, m in fair if m == "strong"]
    estr = ", ".join("<<%d, %d, %d>>" % (s, aidx[lab], t) for s, lab, t in edges)
    mod = []
    mod.append("---- MODULE ModelData ----")
    mod.append("EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets")
    mod.append("Nodes == 0..%d" % (n - 1))
    mod.append("Initial == %d" % start)
    mod.append("Edges == {%s}" % estr)
    mod.append("ActionNames == <<%s>>" % ", ".join('"%s"' % a for a in anames))
    mod.append("WFIds == {%s}" % ", ".join(wf))
    mod.append("SFIds == {%s}" % ", ".join(sf))
    mod.append("SafeNodes == {%s}" % ", ".join(str(x) for x in safenodes))
    mod.append("DoneNodes == {%s}" % ", ".join(str(x) for x in donenodes))
    mod.append("====")
    module = "\n".join(mod) + "\n"
    config = ("SPECIFICATION Spec\nINVARIANT Safety\nPROPERTY Termination\n"
              "CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE")
    return {"module": module, "config": config}


def parse_json_line(b):
    try:
        text = b.decode("utf-8")
    except Exception:
        raise Err("E_JSON")

    def const_bad(c):
        raise Err("E_JSON")

    def hook(pairs):
        d = {}
        for k, v in pairs:
            if k in d:
                raise Err("E_JSON")
            d[k] = v
        return d

    try:
        return json.loads(text, parse_constant=const_bad, object_pairs_hook=hook)
    except Err:
        raise
    except Exception:
        raise Err("E_JSON")


def handle(req):
    if not isinstance(req, dict):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    op = req.get("op")
    if not isinstance(op, str) or op not in ("replay", "audit", "export"):
        raise Err("E_SCHEMA")
    if op == "replay":
        check_keys(req, ("op", "inputs", "slots", "window", "events"))
        P, R, D, inp = parse_inputs(req["inputs"])
        return do_replay(inp, P, R, D, req)
    if op == "audit":
        check_keys(req, ("op", "inputs", "states", "edges", "start", "fairness"))
        P, R, D, inp = parse_inputs(req["inputs"])
        return do_audit(inp, P, R, D, req)
    check_keys(req, ("op", "inputs", "states", "edges", "start", "fairness"))
    P, R, D, inp = parse_inputs(req["inputs"])
    return do_export(inp, P, R, D, req)


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    if data:
        lines = data.split(b"\n")
        if lines[-1] == b"":
            lines.pop()
    else:
        lines = []
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        try:
            if len(line) > MAX_LINE:
                raise Err("E_LIMIT")
            res = handle(parse_json_line(line))
        except Err as e:
            res = {"error": e.cat}
        out.append(json.dumps(res, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))

"""Brute-force reference for small audit graphs."""
import itertools

def analyse(P,R,D,inp,states,edges,fair,start):
    n=len(states)
    # expected sums
    exp=[]
    for q in range(R):
        s=[0]*D
        for r in range(P):
            v=inp[r][q]
            for i in range(D): s[i]+=v[i]
        exp.append(s)
    def safe(st):
        dl=st["delivered"]
        for r in range(P):
            for q,v in enumerate(dl[r]):
                if v!=exp[q]: return False
        for s in st["slots"]:
            tot=[0]*D
            for r in s["ranks"]:
                v=inp[r][s["seq"]]
                for i in range(D): tot[i]+=v[i]
            if s["sum"]!=tot: return False
        return True
    def donest(st):
        return all(len(st["delivered"][r])==R for r in range(P))
    en={i:0 for i in range(n)}
    bit={a:1<<i for i,(a,m) in enumerate(fair)}
    for eid,(s,lab,t) in enumerate(edges):
        if lab in bit: en[s]|=bit[lab]
    # reachable from start
    reach={start}
    q=[start]
    while q:
        u=q.pop()
        for (s,lab,t) in edges:
            if s==u and t not in reach: reach.add(t); q.append(t)
    # safety over reachable
    saf=all(safe(states[u]) for u in reach)
    # termination: exists recurrent set F of non-done states, strongly connected in induced subgraph
    # (with the convention: single node trivially connected), reachable from start (through non-done)
    nondone=[i for i in range(n) if not donest(states[i])]
    exists=False; witness=None
    decl=[a for a,m in fair]
    weak=[bit[a] for a,m in fair if m=='weak']
    strongidx=[i for i,(a,m) in enumerate(fair) if m=='strong']
    # reachability graph restricted to nondone
    ndset=set(nondone)
    def bfs_from(s):
        seen={s}; stk=[s]
        while stk:
            u=stk.pop()
            for (a,lab,t) in edges:
                if a==u and t in ndset and t not in seen: seen.add(t); stk.append(t)
        return seen
    rreach = bfs_from(start) if start in ndset else set()
    for mask in range(1,1<<len(nondone)):
        F=[nondone[i] for i in range(len(nondone)) if (mask>>i)&1]
        Fset=set(F)
        if Fset & rreach or start in Fset:
            pass
        # strong connectivity of induced subgraph
        if len(F)==1:
            ok=True
        else:
            # check reachability among all pairs within F
            ok=True
            for s in F:
                seen={s}; stk=[s]
                while stk:
                    u=stk.pop()
                    for e in edges:
                        if e[0]==u and e[2] in Fset and e[2] not in seen: seen.add(e[2]); stk.append(e[2])
                if seen != Fset: ok=False; break
        if not ok: continue
        fair_ok=True
        for (a,m) in fair:
            b=bit[a]
            internal=any(e for e in edges if e[0] in Fset and e[2] in Fset and e[1]==a)
            enabled=any(en[s]&b for s in F)
            if m=='weak':
                if Fset <= set(s for s in F if en[s]&b) and not internal:
                    # F subset of En_a and no internal edge -> violated
                    if all(en[s]&b for s in F) and not internal: fair_ok=False; break
            else:
                if enabled and not internal: fair_ok=False; break
        if not fair_ok: continue
        # reachable from start through nondone: start in F or start reaches F in ndset
        rr = bfs_from(start) if start in ndset else set()
        if not (Fset & rr):
            continue
        exists=True; witness=F; break
    return saf, (not exists), witness

"""Validate audit answers produced by main.py independently."""
import re
import json

def val_audit(req, out, sim_max=2000):
    P,R,D = len(req["inputs"]), None, None
    # recompute expected
    inp=req["inputs"]; P=len(inp); R=len(inp[0]) if P else 0
    D=len(inp[0][0]) if R else 0
    exp=[]
    for q in range(R):
        s=[0]*D
        for r in range(P):
            v=inp[r][q]
            for i in range(D): s[i]+=v[i]
        exp.append(s)
    states=req["states"]; n=len(states)
    edges=[tuple(e) for e in req["edges"]]; start=req["start"]
    fair=[(f["action"], f["mode"]) for f in req["fairness"]]
    def is_safe(st):
        for r in range(P):
            for q,v in enumerate(st["delivered"][r]):
                if v!=exp[q]: return False
        for sl in st["slots"]:
            tot=[0]*D
            for r in sl["ranks"]:
                v=inp[r][sl["seq"]]
                for i in range(D): tot[i]+=v[i]
            if sl["sum"]!=tot: return False
        return True
    def is_done(st):
        return all(len(st["delivered"][r])==R for r in range(P))
    enb=[set() for _ in range(n)]
    for (s,lab,t) in edges: enb[s].add(lab)
    # adjacency (all edges)
    adj={}
    for eid,(s,lab,t) in enumerate(edges): adj.setdefault(s,[]).append((eid,t))
    # --- safety witness
    if out["safe"] and out["safety"] is not None: return "safe=true but safety given"
    if (not out["safe"]) and out["safety"] is None: return "safe=false but no witness"
    if out["safety"] is not None:
        seq=out["safety"]["prefix"]
        cur=start; visited=[cur]
        for eid in seq:
            if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges): return "bad safety edge id"
            s,lab,t=edges[eid]
            if s!=cur: return "safety edge does not start at current"
            cur=t; visited.append(cur)
        if not (0<=cur<n) or is_safe(states[cur]):
            return "safety prefix ends at safe state"
    # --- liveness witness
    if out["terminates"] and out["liveness"] is not None: return "terminates but witness"
    if (not out["terminates"]) and out["liveness"] is None: return "not terminates but no witness"
    if out["liveness"] is not None:
        pre=out["liveness"]["prefix"]; loop=out["liveness"]["loop"]
        if not loop: return "empty loop"
        cur=start
        for eid in pre:
            if eid==-1:
                pass
            else:
                if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges): return "bad prefix edge id"
                s,lab,t=edges[eid]
                if s!=cur: return "prefix edge mismatch"
                cur=t
        states_seen={cur}
        for eid in pre:
            if eid==-1:
                states_seen.add(cur)
            else:
                seen2 = edges[eid][2]
                if edges[eid][0]!=cur: return "mismatch"
                cur=seen2; states_seen.add(cur)
                if is_done(states[cur]): return "prefix visits done state"
        if is_done(states[cur]): return "prefix end is done"
        loopstates=set()
        curs2=cur
        for eid in loop:
            if eid==-1:
                loopstates.add(cur); continue
            if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges): return "bad loop edge id"
            s,lab,t=edges[eid]
            if s!=cur: return "loop edge mismatch at %d"%eid
            cur=t; loopstates.add(cur)
            if is_done(states[cur]): return "loop visits done state"
        if cur!=curs2: return "loop does not close"
        # fairness
        allst=states_seen | loopstates
        labels_used={(edges[e][1] if e!=-1 else None) for e in loop if e!=-1}
        for (a,mode) in fair:
            enabled_anywhere=any(a in enb[s] for s in loopstates)
            used=a in labels_used
            every_enabled=all(a in enb[s] for s in loopstates)
            if mode=="weak":
                if every_enabled and not used: return "WF %s violated"%a
            else:
                if enabled_anywhere and not used: return "SF %s violated"%a
    return None

def val_export(req, out):
    mod=out["module"]
    assert mod.startswith("---- MODULE ModelData ----")
    assert mod.rstrip().endswith("====")
    lines=[l for l in mod.split("\n") if l.strip()]

    residue = residue.strip().strip("{}").strip()
    assert residue=="" , repr(residue)
    edges=[tuple(e) for e in req["edges"]]
    # names

    names=re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', defs[3]) if m.group(1).strip() else []
    assert names==sorted(set(names)) or True
    allnames=set()
    for e in edges: allnames.add(e[1])
    for f in req["fairness"]: allnames.add(f["action"])
    assert set(names)==allnames, (names, allnames)
    assert names==sorted(allnames)
    aidx={a:i+1 for i,a in enumerate(names)}
    assert len(trip)==len(edges)
    for t,(s,lab,tg) in zip(trip, edges):
        assert t[0]==s and t[1]==aidx[lab] and t[2]==tg, (t,(s,lab,tg))
    # WF / SF
    def parse_set(txt):
        m=re.fullmatch(r"\{(.*?)\}", txt)
        if not m: return None
        digits=[]
        if m.group(1).strip():
            for tok in re.finditer(r"(-?\d+)", m.group(1)): digits.append(tok.group(1))
        residue=re.sub(r"(-?\d+)","",m.group(1)).strip()
        assert residue=="", repr(residue)
        return set(int(x) for x in digits)
    wf=parse_set(defs[4]); sf=parse_set(defs[5])
    expwf={aidx[a] for a,m2 in [(f["action"],f["mode"]) for f in req["fairness"]] if m2=="weak"}
    expsf={aidx[a] for a,m2 in [(f["action"],f["mode"]) for f in req["fairness"]] if m2=="strong"}
    assert wf==expwf, (wf,expwf)
    assert sf==expsf, (sf,expsf)
    safe=parse_set(defs[6]); done=parse_set(defs[7])
    P=len(req["inputs"]); R=len(req["inputs"][0]) if P else 0; D=len(req["inputs"][0][0]) if R else 0
    exp=[]
    for q in range(R):
        s=[0]*D
        for r in range(P):
            v=req["inputs"][r][q]
            for i in range(D): s[i]+=v[i]
        exp.append(s)
    for i,st in enumerate(req["states"]):
        safeok=True
        for r in range(P):
            for qq,v in enumerate(st["delivered"][r]):
                if v!=exp[qq]: safeok=False
        for sl in st["slots"]:
            tot=[0]*D
            for r in sl["ranks"]:
                v=req["inputs"][r][sl["seq"]]
                for j in range(D): tot[j]+=v[j]
            if sl["sum"]!=tot: safeok=False
        assert safeok==(i in safe), ("safenode",i)
        isdone=all(len(st["delivered"][r])==R for r in range(P))
        assert isdone==(i in done), ("donenode",i)
    cfg=out["config"]
    toks=cfg.split()
    assert toks==["SPECIFICATION","Spec","INVARIANT","Safety","PROPERTY","Termination","CHECK_DEADLOCK","FALSE"], toks
    return None

def comp_bfs(seed, adjl, nc):
    """seed: node indices at distance 0; adjl: adjacency lists of (eid, other)."""
    dist = [-1] * nc
    pnode = [-1] * nc
    peid = [0] * nc
    q = []
    for s in seed:
        if dist[s] < 0:
            dist[s] = 0
            q.append(s)
    qi = 0
    while qi < len(q):
        u = q[qi]
        qi += 1
        d = dist[u] + 1
        for eid, t in adjl[u]:
            if dist[t] < 0:
                dist[t] = d
                pnode[t] = u
                peid[t] = eid
                q.append(t)
    return dist, pnode, peid


def parent_path(dist, peid, pnode, src):
    """list of (eid, target) steps walking src backwards to a distance-0 node"""
    chain = []
    w = src
    while dist[w] > 0:
        chain.append((peid[w], w))
        w = pnode[w]
    chain.reverse()
    return chain, w


def build_fair_loop(cprot, edges, fair, enm_state, tgt):
    """Closed walk of edge ids over cprot beginning at tgt; satisfies every
    declared fairness condition.  Returns None when impossible."""
    nfair = len(fair)
    DECL = (1 << nfair) - 1
    SDECL = 0
    WDECL = 0
    lbl_bit = {}
    for i, (a, m) in enumerate(fair):
        lbl_bit[a] = 1 << i
        if m == "strong":
            SDECL |= 1 << i
        else:
            WDECL |= 1 << i
    nodes = sorted(cprot)
    nc = len(nodes)
    idx = {}
    for i, s in enumerate(nodes):
        idx[s] = i
    emask = [0] * nc
    dmask = [0] * nc
    for i in range(nc):
        en = enm_state[nodes[i]]
        emask[i] = en & DECL
        dmask[i] = (~en) & DECL
    fwd = [[] for _ in range(nc)]
    bwd = [[] for _ in range(nc)]
    ie = []
    for eid in range(len(edges)):
        s, lab, t = edges[eid]
        if s in cprot and t in cprot:
            u = idx[s]
            v = idx[t]
            fwd[u].append((eid, v))
            bwd[v].append((eid, u))
            ie.append((u, v, eid, lbl_bit.get(lab, 0)))
    tgti = idx[tgt]
    covA = dmask[tgti]
    covEn = emask[tgti]
    walk_mask = 0
    covered = set([tgti])
    # initial closed walk: cycle through tgti
    dist, pnode, peid = comp_bfs([tgti], fwd, nc)
    best = None
    for u, v, eid, ab in ie:
        if v == tgti and dist[u] >= 0 and (best is None or dist[u] < best[0]):
            best = (dist[u], u, eid)
    if best is None:
        # no cycle through tgti: only the implicit stutter is available
        if (covEn & ~walk_mask & SDECL) | (~covA & ~walk_mask & WDECL):
            return None
        return [-1]
    _, srcu, backeid = best
    W = []
    chain0, x = parent_path(dist, peid, pnode, srcu)
    chain0.append((backeid, tgti))
    for e, t in chain0:
        W.append([e, t])
        covered.add(t)
        covA |= dmask[t]
        covEn |= emask[t]
        walk_mask |= lbl_bit.get(edges[e][1], 0)
    while True:
        viol = (covEn & ~walk_mask & SDECL) | (~covA & ~walk_mask & WDECL)
        if viol == 0:
            break
        abit = viol & -viol
        covlist = list(covered)
        df, fpar, feid = comp_bfs(covlist, fwd, nc)
        db, bpar, beid = comp_bfs(covlist, bwd, nc)
        bestc = None
        for u, v, eid, ab in ie:
            if ab == abit and df[u] >= 0 and db[v] >= 0:
                cost = df[u] + 1 + db[v]
                if bestc is None or cost < bestc[0]:
                    bestc = (cost, u, v, eid)
        if bestc is None:
            return None
        _, u, v, eida = bestc
        chain, x = parent_path(df, feid, fpar, u)
        chain.append((eida, v))
        chain2, y = parent_path(db, beid, bpar, v)
        chain.extend(chain2)
        # insert after the walk segment ending at x
        at_x = None
        for i in range(len(W) - 1, -1, -1):
            if W[i][1] == x:
                at_x = i
                break
        if at_x is None:
            return None
        W[at_x + 1:at_x + 1] = list(chain)
        for e, t in chain:
            covered.add(t)
            covA |= dmask[t]
            covEn |= emask[t]
            walk_mask |= lbl_bit.get(edges[e][1], 0)
    return [e for e, _ in W]

## `replay`: the bounded switch and its two acknowledgment paths

The exact request keys are `op,inputs,slots,window,events`; `1 <= slots <= 16`, `1 <= window <= slots`. `events` has at most 20000 arrays, each one of:

* `["send", rank, q]`, where `0 <= rank < P`, `0 <= q < R`;
* `["retry", rank]`;
* `["deliver", packet_id]`, `["drop", packet_id]`, or `["duplicate", packet_id]`, with `0 <= packet_id <= 200000`.

All state starts empty or zero. Each host has `sent` (its cumulatively acknowledged upstream prefix length) and `received` (an ordered list of result vectors). The switch has `floor=0`, `up_next[r]=0`, and `acked[r]=0`. Its circular buffer has `slots` physical entries indexed by `q % slots`; each occupied entry retains its absolute sequence tag `q`, a set of contributing ranks, and their vector sum. A full entry contains all `P` ranks. Never clear a slot on aggregation or on an upstream ACK. It is released only by the minimum of all downstream cumulative ACKs.

A packet has exactly `id,kind,rank,seq,value`. Kinds are `up,uack,down,dack`. `up` and `down` carry vector `value`; ACKs carry `null`. Data `seq` is a sequence index; ACK `seq` is an exclusive prefix length. `rank` identifies the host on either direction. Packets are immutable once created. IDs are consecutive from zero in creation order. Every creation appends to the pending packet map. Deliver/drop remove the named pending packet before further processing. A duplicate creates an identical packet with a fresh ID and retains the original. A missing ID makes the event `missing` and changes nothing.

Process events sequentially:

1. `send`: enabled precisely when `sent[rank] <= q < min(R,sent[rank]+window)`. Create one `up` with the original input vector. Otherwise return event status `disabled`, changing nothing. Sending an already pending request is allowed.
2. `retry`: for that rank, create `down` packets for every full occupied entry with `q >= acked[rank]`, in increasing `q` order. It is always enabled, even if it creates nothing. This is the switch timeout, independent of host transmission progress.
3. Deliver `up(r,q)`: if `floor <= q < floor+slots`, find/create the tagged entry and add the contribution only if `r` is absent. Then advance `up_next[r]` while the entry for that sequence exists and contains `r`. Create one `uack(r,up_next[r])`. If this arrival changed the entry from incomplete to full, create `down` packets to ranks `0..P-1` in that order after the ACK. A duplicate full contribution does not regenerate results. For `q` outside that range, store/aggregate nothing and create only `uack(r,up_next[r])`; an unchanged cumulative ACK also serves as a negative acknowledgment. In particular, old packets cannot alias a reused slot.
4. Deliver `uack(r,k)`: set `sent[r]=max(sent[r],k)`.
5. Deliver `down(r,q,v)`: if `q == len(received[r])`, append `v`; otherwise discard the data, including ahead-of-order data. In all cases create `dack(r,len(received[r]))`. Previously emitted result packets remain deliverable after slot reuse.
6. Deliver `dack(r,k)`: set `acked[r]=max(acked[r],k)`, then `floor=min(acked)`. Clear precisely the occupied entries whose sequence is below the new floor.
7. Drop: no further processing. Duplicate: only the copy described above.

All ordinary events have status `ok`. If a request ever exceeds 2048 simultaneously pending packets or 200000 total packet creations, return `E_LIMIT` for the entire request, with no partial replay response. Those bounds limit only the explicit replay; they are not assumptions of the temporal audit.

The response has exactly `hosts,floor,slots,packets,events`. `hosts` is rank ordered, each entry exactly `{"sent":integer,"received":[vectors...]}`. `slots` is sequence ordered, each entry exactly `{"seq":q,"ranks":[sorted ranks],"sum":vector}`. `packets` is ID ordered and contains every pending packet with the exact five fields above. `events` has one entry per event, exactly `{"status":"ok|disabled|missing","created":[new IDs in creation order]}`. Do not include internal `up_next` or `acked` fields.
